title: Ezekiel Eats with Trembling as a Sign
description: The word of the Lord comes to Ezekiel, and he is commanded to eat his bread with trembling and drink his water in dread and anxiety. This is a prophetic sign of the terror and dismay that will strike the people of Jerusalem when the land is laid waste because of violence and the cities become ruins. In this way, the people will know that I am the Lord [ref:Ezekiel 12:17-20|Ezekiel 12:17-20].
